description: Source file implementing Bluetooth utility functions for device management, address conversion, and Bluetooth route determination within the Thunder::Bluetooth namespace.

methods.name: BtUtilsHciForEachDevice
methods.description: Iterates over Bluetooth devices matching a flag and applies a callback function.

methods.name: BtUtilsHciDevInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific Bluetooth device.

methods.name: BtUtilsHciDevba
methods.description: Gets the Bluetooth address of a device if it is up.

methods.name: BtUtilsOtherBdaddr
methods.description: Checks if a device's Bluetooth address differs from a given address.

methods.name: BtUtilsSameBdaddr
methods.description: Checks if a device's Bluetooth address matches a given address.

methods.name: BtUtilsHciGetRoute
methods.description: Finds the Bluetooth device ID associated with a given address.

methods.name: BtUtilsBa2Str
methods.description: Converts a Bluetooth address to a string representation.

methods.name: BtUtilsBachk
methods.description: Validates the format of a Bluetooth address string.

methods.name: BtUtilsStr2Ba
methods.description: Converts a Bluetooth address string to a bdaddr_t structure.

methods.name: BtUtilsBa2Oui
methods.description: Converts a Bluetooth address to an OUI string.

methods.name: BtUtilsBaswap
methods.description: Swaps the byte order of a Bluetooth address.
